title: Updated CV
details: Include valid details supported by existing evidence.

title: Passport photograph
details: MRP photograph meeting the immigration photograph requirements specified in the supplied checklist.

title: Valid passport and previous passport copy
details: Copy of a valid passport. Include a previous passport copy if applicable.

title: Citizenship certificate
details: Provide the applicant’s citizenship certificate.

title: Birth verification or registration
details: Provide birth verification or birth registration.

title: Police report
details: The supplied checklist requests a valid police report no more than 3 months old.

title: Valid offer letter
details: Provide a valid offer letter from the education provider.

title: English proficiency test certificate
details: Provide a valid English proficiency test score certificate.

title: Academic documents and professional registration
details: Provide academic documents, including any necessary registration or licence.

title: Gap evidence documents (if applicable)
source: Applicant / employer / training or volunteer organisation
details: Evidence of internships, training or volunteering submitted at the college interview, if any. Include relevant pay checks, bank statements, TDS records, employment letters and contract or appointment letters.

title: Handwritten Statement of Purpose
details: The supplied checklist requests an SOP handwritten by the student personally.

title: Pre-medical examination evidence
details: The supplied checklist states that the examination must be performed after the offer and submitted with the visa application. It lists Norvic, TMMC, Nepal Mendicity and IOM as providers.

title: Loan sanction letter and mortgage deed
details: Submit with the visa application for loan-funded cases. The supplied checklist specifies Nabil or Nepal SBI Bank.

title: Funds and liquid savings evidence
details: The supplied checklist states 60 lakhs and around 10 lakhs in liquid funds, with evidence of relevant sources. It does not specify the currency in this line.

title: Property valuation and land ownership
details: Provide property valuation and land ownership documents, including bank valuation.

title: Property and land tax receipts (if applicable)
details: Property and land tax receipts for the last 3 years, if applicable.

title: Tax clearance certificates
details: Provide tax clearance certificates.

title: Sponsor relationship verification and citizenship
details: Provide relationship verification documents and sponsors’ citizenship certificates. The supplied checklist specifies immediate family members and siblings as sponsors.

title: Sponsorship letter
details: Provide a sponsorship letter.

title: Form INZ 1226
details: Provide Form INZ 1226 as listed in the supplied checklist.

title: Income certificate
details: Provide an income certificate from the ward, with supporting evidence for the applicable income sources below.

title: Employment income evidence (if applicable)
source: Employer / bank / relevant fund or tax authority
details: Employment letter, PAN, pay checks, TDS, statements, and EPF, CIT and SST statements, as applicable to the employment income claimed.

title: Business income evidence (if applicable)
details: PAN, renewed business registration, TDS for 3 years, statements and an audit report from an authorised auditor. The supplied checklist describes the auditor as authorised in IRRC.

title: Lease income evidence (if applicable)
details: Notarised lease agreement, tenant’s citizenship certificate (CC), lease tax records and bank statements.

title: Agricultural income evidence (if applicable)
details: Ward certificate with tax exemption and supporting documents. The supplied checklist states agricultural income must be below 4 lakhs; it does not specify the currency or period in this line.

title: Vehicle income evidence (if applicable)
details: Renewed blue book, insurance, and an agreement or income letter.

title: Foreign income evidence (if applicable)
details: Income or employment letter, valid residency card, passport, visa copy, pay checks, statements and other relevant supporting evidence.

title: Ward or DAO verification documents (if applicable)
details: Supporting verification documents such as name verification or address verification, where applicable.

title: Clarification and declaration letters (if requested)
details: Provide clarification or declaration letters and supporting evidence when requested to satisfy the visa officer. The supplied checklist notes that submitted documents may be digitally verified or investigated for authenticity.

title: Fee payment proof after Approval in Principle
details: After receiving Approval in Principle (AIP), transfer funds to the education provider as invoiced and provide payment proof. The supplied checklist says the funds should come from the same original funding source: loan funds for a loan case or bank balance for a balance-funded case. It states payment proof is usually requested within 7 days.

title: Loan disbursement letter, SWIFT copy and account statement
details: For loan-funded cases after AIP: provide the loan disbursement letter, SWIFT payment copy and loan account statement, together with fee payment evidence.

title: SWIFT copy and bank balance account statement
details: For balance-funded cases after AIP: provide the SWIFT payment copy and bank balance account statement after fee payment.
